summary_en: 2,414,783 shares acquired via ToSTNeT-3 from Nomura Securities in adjustment period 3 of FCSR buyback program. Average stock price ¥23,832.45. Adjustment: 28,100 shares added via gratuitous acquisition from warrant holders.
title_en: Notice of Post-Adjustment for Commitment-Type Share Buyback (FCSR)
translation_en_brief:
This notice reports the final determination of shares acquired in adjustment period 3 of Daikin Industries' FCSR (Commitment-type Free Cash Flow Based Share Repurchase) program, which was originally announced on May 12, 2026. The post-adjustment acquisition results for the third of six adjustment periods have been confirmed.

During adjustment period 3, covering May 14 to August 12, 2026, the company acquired 2,414,783 shares (representing 1/6 of the total May 13 ToSTNeT-3 block purchase from Nomura Securities). The arithmetic mean share price over the adjustment period, adjusted by a factor of 99.506% applied to the VWAP on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, was ¥23,832.45. An additional 28,100 shares were acquired gratuitously from warrant holders as part of the adjustment mechanism, bringing the final adjusted total to 2,414,783 shares. No dividend adjustment was applied (adjustment factor ¥0).
